selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent and loaded inventory-config rule before and after reboot, with auditd active and enabled.
The post-reboot change succeeded; audit records show success=yes, /etc/inventory.conf, and key=inventory-config.
The nobody-user change failed; audit records show success=no, EPERM, /etc/inventory.conf, and key=inventory-config.

Baseline boot ID was 4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is f899e08c-2d8d-4a5a-b9cc-12b266b4fe0e. Post-restart evidence shows a running system, active auditd, restored rule, unchanged file checksum, zero lost audit events, and functional success/failure logging.
